questions.title: COUNT Star Meaning
questions.description: What does COUNT(*) count?
questions.Option1: Only non-NULL values of one column
questions.Option2: Every row of the group or table

questions.title: COUNT Column Meaning
questions.description: region has NULLs. What does COUNT(region) return?
questions.Option3: Rows where region is not NULL

questions.title: SUM Of Nothing
questions.description: What does SUM(amount) return when zero rows match the WHERE clause?

questions.title: AVG And NULLs
questions.description: How does AVG(amount) treat rows where amount is NULL?
questions.Option4: Ignores them — it averages only non-NULL values

questions.title: MIN MAX And NULLs
questions.description: How do MIN and MAX treat NULL values in the column?
questions.Option1: They return NULL if any NULL exists

questions.title: Rounding Averages
questions.description: What does ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) do?
questions.Option4: Formats the number as currency text

questions.title: DISTINCT Inside COUNT
questions.description: What does COUNT(DISTINCT donor) return?
questions.Option1: Each distinct non-NULL donor counted once

questions.title: group_concat Default Separator
questions.description: With no second argument, what separator does group_concat use?

questions.title: Aggregate Without GROUP BY
questions.description: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM donations; (no GROUP BY) returns how many rows?
questions.Option4: Exactly one row over the whole table

questions.title: MAX On Text
questions.description: What does MAX(donor) return on a TEXT column?

questions.title: SUM Of All NULLs
questions.description: If every value in a column is NULL, what does SUM(col) return?
questions.Option4: NULL — no non-NULL values to sum

questions.title: AVG Equals Sum Over Count
questions.description: The snippet returns two columns. How do they compare?
questions.Option1: They are equal — AVG is the sum over the non-NULL count
questions.Option4: One of them raises an error
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT SUM(amount) / COUNT(amount), AVG(amount)
FROM donations;

questions.title: COUNT Vs COUNT DISTINCT
questions.description: donor has repeated names but no NULLs. How do the two columns compare?
questions.Option2: COUNT(DISTINCT donor) is smaller when names repeat
questions.codesnippet:
SELECT COUNT(donor), COUNT(DISTINCT donor)
FROM donations;

questions.title: group_concat Order Caveat
questions.description: What is guaranteed about the order of values inside group_concat output?
questions.Option3: Not guaranteed — feed it an ORDER BY-ed subquery when order matters

questions.title: Why ROUND Money
questions.description: Why wrap money aggregates in ROUND(x, 2)?
questions.Option2: Averages produce long float tails; ROUND(..., 2) renders clean cents

questions.title: MAX With A Bare Column
questions.description: In SQLite, what does SELECT donor, MAX(amount) FROM donations; return for donor?
questions.Option1: The donor from the row holding the maximum (SQLite's bare-column rule)

questions.title: COUNT Star Vs COUNT Column
questions.description: Which statement about COUNT(*) and COUNT(x) is exact?
questions.Option1: COUNT(*) excludes rows where x is NULL
questions.Option3: COUNT(*) counts all rows; COUNT(x) skips rows where x is NULL
questions.Option4: COUNT(x) counts NULLs as empty strings

questions.title: Distinct group_concat Form
questions.description: Which call is valid SQLite for concatenating distinct values?

questions.title: NULL Drops Out Of SUM
questions.description: If some amount values were NULL, what does the snippet return?
questions.Option1: The sum skipping those rows — NULL expressions drop out of SUM
questions.Option2: The sum treating them as 0 plus a warning

questions.title: Nested Aggregates
questions.description: What does SELECT MAX(AVG(amount)) FROM donations; do?
questions.Option2: Returns the average of per-row averages
questions.Option3: Returns zero — the inner aggregate resets
questions.Option4: Errors — one aggregate cannot wrap another
